note: Camping area at Dominion Energy's Bath County Power Station Recreational Ponds near Back Creek (two ponds, 27 and 45 acres); the recreation area is jointly owned with Allegheny Energy and operated by Dominion. --Claude
summary: The operator's page (Dominion Energy) says only that the recreation area is open to the public April-October, 7 a.m.-10 p.m., and that it issues camping permits for a fee; it gives no campsite count, rate, booking method or campground season. DWR's waterbody page adds 'Seasonal lakeside camping, picnic shelter, bathhouse ... There is a small fee' with a 'Primitive Camping Only' tag and confirms the entry's phone (540-279-3289). Nothing structured written. Note corrected: it is Dominion's, not a county campground, and it does document water (the ponds).
flags: Criteria (human decides): no operator page publishes a campsite count, size limit, rate or booking channel. Dominion's page (https://www.dominionenergy.com/about/lakes-and-recreation/bath-county-va) only says 'Dominion Energy reserves the right to revoke camping and daytime use permits ... unused fees will be refunded' and that the recreation area is 'open to the general public April-October'. DWR (https://dwr.virginia.gov/waterbody/bath-county-recreation-ponds/) says 'Primitive Camping Only' and 'There is a small fee to use the facilities'. The inclusion evidence (30 sites, RVs to 45 ft, FCFS) rests on allstays/AAA. As a private (utility) entry it has no posted price.
Waterfront re-audit lead (agency claim differs; waterfront not changed): DWR describes 'Seasonal lakeside camping' at the ponds, while the entry is 'lakeview'.

Website: the entry's Dominion page is the operator's but says almost nothing about camping; DWR's https://dwr.virginia.gov/waterbody/bath-county-recreation-ponds/ is the only official page describing the campground and carries the phone 540-279-3289.
